title: CPU-GPU Co-Design for Agentic LLM Inference
description: Synthesis of Andy Luo's MI300X, vLLM, and LMCache benchmark showing that CPU overhead is negligible for single long-context requests but becomes a 10-15% latency tax at high-concurrency agentic inference, mostly from scheduling and queue wait rather than tokenization.

documents.title: vLLM Hybrid KV Cache Manager
documents.description: vLLM Hybrid KV Cache Manager explains how vLLM allocates and prefix-caches KV blocks for hybrid LLMs that mix full attention, sliding-window attention, local attention, Mamba-style state, or KV-sharing layers. It summarizes the grouping rules, memory layout, coordinator stack, prefix-cache intersection logic, and operational flags such as disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager.
